$comment: Applied-order ledger for the feature-level migration contracts in src/db/migrations. Ordinals must be unique; check:migrations fails the build otherwise. `renames` records every renumbering so an environment that applied a migration under its previous name is not asked to re-run it.

renames.reason: Shared the 006_ ordinal with 006_add_webhook_outbox_dispatch_index, so the applied order depended on filename sorting instead of intent.
